To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Admin. Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIM Kozhikode Admin. Associate posts is 16th September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Admin. Associate post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Admin. Associate position at the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a Post-Graduation with at least two years of experience or Graduation with at least three years of experience in clerical duties or office administration. Proficiency in MS-Office and good communication skills are also essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Admin. Associate role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Admin. Associate position is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Admin. Associate position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be offered a consolidated salary of Rs. 24,300/- per month for the Admin. Associate role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Admin. Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview conducted via video conference, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIM Kozhikode Admin. Associate recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Admin. Associate post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to the official notification PDF and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website of IIM Kozhikode is also provided.
